content.text:
cms UP at check 6
cms: 200
available=751MB

observation.command:
for i in $(seq 1 7); do
  code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 3 -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1:45423/ 2>/dev/null)
  [ "$code" = "200" ] && { echo "cms UP at check $i"; break; }
  sleep 50
done
curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 3 -w "cms: %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:45423/ 2>/dev/null; free -m | sed -n '2p' | awk '{print "available="$6"MB"}'
